### God’s Straight Edge
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/gods-straight-edge
Passage: Romans 3:23
Points:
- God's character represents absolute perfection, righteousness, and holiness.
- Relating to God requires matching His standard of flawless perfection.
- Although human efforts may produce impressive deeds, all people fail to reach that standard.
- The straight edge of the law exposes how crooked and insufficient human righteousness truly is.

### Why Are You Still Working for Grace?
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-march-13-2026.html
Passage: Romans 3:24
Points:
- People often mistakenly believe salvation must be earned through good works or morality.
- Religion focuses on what people must do, whereas the gospel rests on what Jesus already did.
- Christ fully paid the penalty for sin upon the cross, completely finishing the work of redemption.
- Right standing with God cannot be bought or earned; it must be received as a free gift.
